purpose: Evidence ledger for loop engineering experiments

experiments.hypothesis: A minimal static loop can be deployed and observed safely.
experiments.change: Initialize Loop Engineering Lab.
experiments.next: Add measurable persistence and deterministic self-test.

experiments.hypothesis: The loop can persist local telemetry and expose deterministic health checks.
experiments.change: Add Loop Health, local history, and SELF TEST.
experiments.next: Stress the feedback loop repeatedly.

experiments.hypothesis: Ten explicit feedback cycles can execute without breaking the control surface.
experiments.change: Add STRESS 10×.
experiments.next: Make experiment evidence machine-readable and validate the ledger in CI.

experiments.hypothesis: Experiment evidence becomes more inspectable when it is machine-readable and visible in the app.
experiments.change: Add loop/experiments.json, validate its schema in CI, and render the ledger.
experiments.next: Attach structured CI/deployment metadata and test controlled recovery.

experiments.hypothesis: A lightweight static loop can carry structured experiment metadata and detect/recover from a controlled local failure without touching production.
experiments.change: Add evidence metadata, CI report generation, invariant checks, and a local CHAOS RECOVERY experiment.
evidence: Production URL reached Vercel authentication redirect (HTTP 302); deployment itself is READY
experiments.next: Make deployment/CI metadata first-class fields and automate evidence collection without relying on prose.

experiments.hypothesis: The loop becomes more reliable when evidence is represented as structured fields and CI enforces the evidence contract.
experiments.change: Add a structured evidence object to EXP-006 and enforce required evidence fields in CI.
experiments.next: Automate evidence collection so CI/deployment identifiers are generated from observed run context rather than manually entered.

experiments.hypothesis: The engineering loop becomes commercially useful when every experiment is explicitly connected to a business event and a revenue-oriented metric, while unconnected metrics remain visibly unmeasured.
experiments.change: Add a machine-readable business model, business event funnel, revenue north-star metric, and UI guardrails that distinguish observed business data from placeholders.
experiments.next: Connect one real analytics source and one payment/revenue source, then run the first observed revenue experiment without treating placeholders as business outcomes.

experiments.hypothesis: A concrete offer and a measurable purchase-intent event will create the first observable monetization signal before payment integration.
experiments.change: Add a reversible offer card and local-only purchase-interest event probe; do not claim a purchase or revenue.
experiments.next: Connect a real analytics source and define a concrete offer/pricing assumption, then run the smallest externally observable conversion experiment; keep revenue NOT_CONNECTED until payment evidence exists.

experiments.hypothesis: A provider-neutral analytics event contract with explicit local-vs-connected state will make the first external behavior measurement safe to integrate without fabricating customer or revenue data.
experiments.change: Add an analytics integration contract describing required events, identity, observation window, provider state, and connection guardrails; keep the provider unconnected until a real analytics source is configured.
experiments.next: Connect one real analytics provider and verify a real VISIT or TRIAL_STARTED event end-to-end; keep revenue NOT_CONNECTED until payment evidence exists.

experiments.hypothesis: A first-party Vercel Web Analytics ingestion path can provide the first external VISIT signal while keeping business and revenue reporting disabled until receipt is verified.
experiments.change: Enable the Vercel Web Analytics script on the static site and emit VISIT plus TRIAL_STARTED through the documented client event interface; keep the vendor-neutral contract NOT_CONNECTED until an external receipt is confirmed.

analytics.note: The production page and Vercel Insights script route are present, but an external Analytics receipt has not yet been independently observed. Connection state remains NOT_CONNECTED.

experiments.next: Obtain independent Vercel Web Analytics receipt evidence for VISIT or TRIAL_STARTED; if unavailable, diagnose project-level Analytics activation/visibility and run the smallest safe verification loop. Keep revenue NOT_CONNECTED until payment evidence exists.

experiments.hypothesis: If Vercel Analytics initializes after the application script, a bounded client-side queue will preserve the first VISIT signal instead of dropping it while keeping connected reporting disabled until external receipt is verified.
experiments.change: Queue VISIT and other business events when window.va is not ready, retry for a bounded period, and flush once the Vercel Analytics client event interface becomes available.
experiments.next: Verify the production page in a real browser and obtain independent Vercel Web Analytics receipt evidence; only then update connection state.

experiments.hypothesis: The missing HTML-side Vercel Analytics initialization may be preventing the documented window.va queue from existing before the app emits VISIT; initializing the queue before the Insights script should preserve the event and enable external receipt.
experiments.change: Add the documented window.va/window.vaq initialization immediately before the Vercel Insights script in the static HTML page.
experiments.next: Deploy and verify the production page with a real browser or external Analytics receipt; only promote connection state after observed receipt.

experiments.hypothesis: If the page can distinguish the Vercel Analytics queue stub from the loaded client, we can diagnose client-side initialization separately from external receipt and avoid treating local dispatch as observed analytics.
experiments.change: Add a small runtime diagnostics panel that reports the Analytics script tag, client readiness, queued-event count, and status without promoting business connection state.

analytics.note: Runtime diagnostics are deployed, but independent Vercel Analytics receipt evidence is still unavailable; connection remains NOT_CONNECTED.

experiments.next: Use the diagnostics to separate client readiness from external receipt; if receipt remains unavailable, obtain authenticated Web Analytics API access or enable project-level Web Analytics, then verify VISIT before touching revenue state.

experiments.hypothesis: A server-side Vercel Web Analytics API probe can convert the current client-side diagnostic gap into independently verifiable VISIT and custom-event evidence without exposing credentials to the browser.
experiments.change: Add a CI-safe analytics probe that queries Vercel Web Analytics visits/count and events/count using a VERCEL_TOKEN secret when configured; without the secret it records NOT_CONNECTED/PENDING instead of fabricating data.
experiments.next: Configure a least-privilege VERCEL_TOKEN GitHub secret, rerun the probe, and promote only observed API counts into the experiment evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: If the analytics API bridge is executed by the actual CI workflow, the loop can distinguish an executable measurement path from an uninvoked probe without exposing credentials or inventing analytics data.
experiments.change: Wire scripts/analytics-probe.mjs into the main CI workflow, validate its syntax, execute it with VERCEL_TOKEN when configured, and publish the result as an artifact.

ci.note: CI executed the probe; VERCEL_TOKEN was absent.

analytics.note: Probe execution is verified, but no VERCEL_TOKEN was configured and no external Analytics receipt was observed. Connection remains NOT_CONNECTED.

experiments.next: Establish a secure VERCEL_TOKEN credential path outside source control, rerun the CI probe, and only then record observed Web Analytics counts. Keep revenue NOT_CONNECTED until payment evidence exists.

experiments.hypothesis: If the Vercel Web Analytics API endpoint is reachable without credentials but returns an authentication boundary, the remaining blocker can be isolated to credential provisioning rather than deployment or API availability.
experiments.change: Make the analytics probe perform a credentialless visits/count request when VERCEL_TOKEN is absent, recording a 401 authentication boundary without failing or claiming analytics data.

http.note: Credentialless API probe reached Vercel Web Analytics endpoint and received HTTP 403.

analytics.note: The endpoint is reachable, but credentialless access is forbidden. No analytics data was claimed.

experiments.next: Provision a Vercel API credential through a secure user-controlled path, add it to GitHub Actions as VERCEL_TOKEN, rerun the probe, and record only observed visits/events counts.

experiments.hypothesis: A server-side checkout adapter plus explicit launch-ready offer can turn the existing purchase-intent probe into a real payment connection point without exposing credentials or claiming revenue before a payment provider is connected.
experiments.change: Add a priced audit offer, a Vercel serverless checkout endpoint driven by CHECKOUT_URL, checkout readiness diagnostics, and ACTIVATION tracking after the first completed loop.

analytics.note: Analytics credential path remains blocked by the existing VERCEL_TOKEN authentication boundary; no analytics or revenue data was claimed.

payment.note: Both preview and production checkout status endpoints return configured=false; no PURCHASE or revenue was claimed.

experiments.next: Connect a real payment provider checkout URL through Vercel environment configuration and a real VERCEL_TOKEN through GitHub Actions; then verify the first real checkout and analytics receipts before promoting PURCHASE or revenue.

experiments.hypothesis: A machine-checkable control-plane audit can detect stale evidence, contradictory connection states, and unsafe claims before they reach production, making the revenue loop self-correcting rather than dependent on manual review.
experiments.change: Add a CI audit that validates analytics/payment connection guards, prevents PURCHASE/revenue claims while sources are disconnected, verifies every structured experiment has coherent evidence fields, and checks the current ledger for known contradiction patterns.

analytics.note: Vercel Analytics still requires the external VERCEL_TOKEN credential; no analytics data was claimed.

payment.note: Production checkout endpoint was independently verified HTTP 200 and explicitly reports configured=false; no purchase or revenue was claimed.

experiments.next: Connect real Analytics and payment credentials through secure external configuration; the control-plane gate will prevent premature promotion of observed business metrics.

experiments.hypothesis: When external credentials are eventually connected, the system should resume measurement automatically on a schedule instead of requiring another manual engineering cycle.
experiments.change: Add a scheduled autonomous sentinel plus optional production smoke test; persist machine-readable readiness states and never promote disconnected state into observed revenue.
experiments.next: Let the scheduled sentinel run after credentials are configured; verify authenticated analytics receipt and real payment evidence before promoting any business state.

experiments.hypothesis: A concrete deliverable description should make the paid offer easier to evaluate than a generic audit description.
experiments.change: Add a five-part deliverable preview covering diagnosis, bottleneck identification, experiment backlog, measurement design, and next action.
experiments.next: Observe offer interaction and checkout intent after the deliverable clarification is deployed; do not infer purchase or revenue from clicks.

experiments.hypothesis: A free, concrete diagnostic preview can let a visitor experience the value of the paid audit before checkout.
experiments.change: Add a three-question local diagnostic that returns a preliminary finding and next experiment without claiming purchase or revenue.
experiments.next: Observe completion and checkout-intent events after deployment; compare behavior only when real analytics is connected.

experiments.hypothesis: A direct CTA revealed only after the free diagnostic result will reduce the gap between experienced value and the paid audit decision.
experiments.change: Reveal a contextual Audit CTA after the local diagnostic completes, while keeping checkout truthfully disconnected until payment configuration exists.
experiments.next: Observe demo completion and subsequent checkout-intent behavior once real analytics is connected.

experiments.hypothesis: Using the WHATWG URL API directly for checkout query parsing can remove the runtime url.parse deprecation warning from the revenue-critical endpoint.
experiments.change: Replace framework req.query access with WHATWG URL parsing while preserving checkout/status behavior.

runtimeErrors.observation: No runtime errors in selected 15m window after deployment

experiments.next: Recheck runtime error aggregation after deployment; if warning persists, attribute it to the platform/runtime rather than application parsing.

experiments.hypothesis: When external credentials are absent, the production loop must remain explicitly disconnected-safe; when credentials appear, the scheduled loop must automatically transition to authenticated verification without manual code changes.
experiments.change: Define and persist an explicit external-boundary readiness experiment covering VERCEL_TOKEN, CHECKOUT_URL, authenticated Analytics probing, production checkout status, and truthful revenue guardrails.

http.note: Production smoke test completed successfully in CI run 97.

analytics.note: No authenticated Analytics receipt claimed; external VERCEL_TOKEN remains required.

payment.note: Checkout remains disconnected until CHECKOUT_URL and an actual payment transaction are configured/confirmed.

experiments.next: Keep the scheduled sentinel active; when external credentials become available, automatically verify authenticated Analytics and checkout, then record only real PURCHASE/REVENUE evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: After the CI integrity fix is merged, the production revenue loop should retain a clean technical control plane while remaining explicitly disconnected from external Analytics and payment credentials.
experiments.change: Isolate the control-plane audit syntax check in CI, merge the fix to main, and verify the resulting production deployment and commercial boundary state without promoting unobserved analytics, purchase, or revenue.

http.note: Production deployment is READY on the merged main commit; the scheduled production smoke contract remains the authoritative HTTP check.

analytics.note: No authenticated Analytics receipt; VERCEL_TOKEN is not configured.

payment.note: Checkout remains disconnected; CHECKOUT_URL is not configured and no real PURCHASE/REVENUE transaction is observed.

experiments.next: Resolve the commercial boundary next: make the production customer path publicly reachable without weakening security, then connect real Analytics and payment credentials through user-controlled external configuration and let the scheduled sentinel verify only observed business events.

experiments.hypothesis: Production must be reachable by customers while Preview remains protected, so the commercial path can be tested without exposing development deployments.
experiments.change: Change Vercel SSO protection scope from all deployment targets to Preview only, leaving password protection disabled and trusted IP protection disabled; verify the Production deployment remains READY and the project records the intended protection boundary.

ci.note: The Vercel protection change does not itself trigger GitHub Actions; the next main push will verify the repository control plane.

preview.note: Preview deployments remain protected by Vercel Authentication under the project setting.

http.note: The connected browser fetcher could not independently retrieve the Vercel URL; no HTTP success is claimed from that limitation.

analytics.note: No authenticated Vercel Analytics receipt; VERCEL_TOKEN remains externally unconfigured.

payment.note: CHECKOUT_URL remains externally unconfigured; no PURCHASE or REVENUE is observed.

experiments.next: Use the now-public Production boundary to verify the customer path, then connect real Analytics and payment credentials through user-controlled external configuration; never promote intent into PURCHASE or REVENUE.
